environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer). The feature flag service (Split.io self-hosted relay) is configured with the flag 'search-rich-preview-v2' set to TRUE for all environments as part of an ongoing A/B test rollout. No WAF or content filtering is applied at the load balancer layer. The FLAG_SDK_KEY environment variable is set and the relay proxy is reachable at flags.internal:8080.
